fields.statement: At ef3679587: CLAUDE.md is exactly the line @AGENTS.md (cat -A). AGENTS.md matches the old CLAUDE.md word for word apart from its title and intro line (diff against HEAD~1:CLAUDE.md), and holds the sections Ignore the ~/code/.claude/rules files, Stack and shape, Bug requests, Commands, Tests and Binaries. New test TestClaudeMDImportsAgentsMD in cmd/rhiza/claudemd_test.go checks both. The existing TestClaudeMDScopedTests and TestClaudeMDCommandsNameMakeUpdate now read AGENTS.md. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestClaudeMD -v: all 3 PASS. No other Go, Makefile, script or txtar file reads CLAUDE.md. make self-check fails only on unrendered actor files and index.md, which the ship step renders; this is not part of the leaf's acceptance.
